proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Generous daily free points (currently (~14M tokens/day free, allowing hundreds of FLUX.1-schnell and SDXL generations daily for free).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides high-speed, enterprise-grade API access to open-source models (FLUX.1-schnell, SDXL, HunyuanVideo) with an exceptionally generous free tier that doesn't block GitHub Actions IPs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: GitHub Actions image generator pipeline (replaces Pollinations for high-quality FLUX-schnell generation).
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Based in China, documentation can occasionally default to Chinese; API keys require email verification.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to list unlimited assets. 88/12 revenue share (you keep 88%).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: The newly launched unified marketplace replacing Unreal Engine Marketplace, Sketchfab, and Quixel. Huge built-in audience of gamedevs looking for 2D textures, UI packs, and 3D assets.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Gamedev asset pack pipeline (automatically package and list generated UI elements, 2D tilesets, and 3D models).
proposals.risk_or_caveat: High quality standards; assets are manually or semi-automatically reviewed before going live.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free developer account, pay only production costs when an order is placed. No monthly fees.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Allows fully automated, programmatic book creation, printing, and global distribution (including Shopify, Amazon, or direct sales) via a REST API.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Coloring book and low-content book pipelines (bypass manual KDP uploads by sending PDFs straight to print distribution via API).
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires setting up a payment method for base printing costs when fulfilling orders, though can be structured to charge customer first.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to publish. 10% platform fee on direct sales (excluding payment processing).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Prusa's official platform has evolved into a highly lucrative marketplace for 3D printing STL files, rivaling Cults3D with a more active, maker-focused community.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Parametric 3D/STL asset pipeline (upload procedurally generated OpenSCAD/STL files).
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires high-quality printable files; models must be sliced and verified to maintain high ratings.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free trial credits upon registration ($1-$10 value depending on promo), extremely cheap PAYG pricing (e.g., $0.001 per FLUX-schnell generation).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Hyper-optimized model inference. Offers the fastest FLUX.1 and SD3 generation times in the industry with advanced control parameters (img2img, ControlNet).
proposals.would_integrate_where: Fallback generator in GitHub Actions when free services rate limit us; fits easily within the €20/month budget.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires keeping track of credit usage to avoid service interruption during automated batch runs.

proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides structured JSON data for Google Trends, Google Shopping, and eBay listings without needing complex headless browser scrapers.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Niche hunter / Trend intelligence script (run once a week to discover spiking physical product niches).
proposals.risk_or_caveat: 100 searches is low; must be highly targeted and run only during scheduled weekly cron jobs.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 0% platform fee on direct digital product sales (only standard stripe/paypal fees apply).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Allows setting up a slick digital storefront for asset packs, PDFs, or 3D files with zero monthly platform costs, complete with webhook triggers to automate delivery.
proposals.would_integrate_where: B2B direct sales and digital asset landing page (sell bundles generated by the pipelines directly to users with zero middleman fees).
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires driving your own traffic; no organic search engine discovery volume compared to Etsy or Redbubble.
